title: "prep data for flumut"
output: html_document
date: "2025-04-10"
---

## objectives
* format for flumut
- sequences separated by segment with a common name for samples
- smaller batches
- MP not M for matrix

* v2 change: don't temporal-outlier-filtered, ft_root_outlier. instead, use 04_clean-align output. Also, use sample in the seq_newflu

## Libs
```{r, message=F}
library(Biostrings)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtools)
library(ape)
```

## Ins and Outs
```{r}
f.nuc.in<-"../../../../04_clean-align/2026-01-12_clean_aligns_wg_out/cleaned_fasta/"
f.met.in<-"../../../../04_clean-align/2026-01-12_clean_aligns_wg_out/cleaned_meta/"
fasta.in<-list.files(f.nuc.in, pattern="nodup_nuc", full.names = T) %>% mixedsort()
meta.in<-list.files(f.met.in, pattern="merged_cleaned_meta", full.names = T) %>% mixedsort()
l.tre<-length(fasta.in)

# Output
today<-Sys.Date()
f.out<-paste0(today,"_format_flumut/")
if(!dir.exists(f.out)){dir.create(f.out)}

# all segments together, ordered by sample|date|segment
#and batch exported in nseq=n.per.file per file
n.per.file<-20000
fasta.out<-paste0(f.out, "flumut_b") #add "<batch-number>.fasta"
meta.out<-paste0(f.out, "meta_flumut_b") #add "<batch-number>.csv"
```

## Read in the trees, data
```{r}
nuc<-meta<-replicate(l.tre, vector())
for(i in 1:l.tre){
  meta[[i]]<-read.csv(file=meta.in[i],header=T)
  nuc[[i]]<-Biostrings::readDNAStringSet(fasta.in[i])
  #full match?
  c(length(which(names(nuc[[i]]) %in% meta[[i]]$seq_new)),nrow(meta[[i]])) %>% print
}

## format names, replace in nuc
for(i in 1:l.tre){
  meta[[i]]$sample<-meta[[i]]$sample %>% 
    str_replace_all(c("_|\\|"="-", #|\\(|\\)|\\/
                      " "=""))
  #flumut formatting requires sample-specific in name. REMOVE date
  meta[[i]]<-meta[[i]] %>% unite(seq_newflu, 
                                 "sample","segment",
                                 sep="_", remove=F)
  
  #flumut formatting requires _, matrix to be MP not M, and no space
  meta[[i]]$seq_newflu<-str_replace_all(meta[[i]]$seq_newflu, 
                                        c("_M$"="_MP"))  
  #replace in the fasta
  names(nuc[[i]])<-meta[[i]]$seq_newflu [match(names(nuc[[i]]), meta[[i]]$seq_new)]
}
```

## Export
```{r}
#bind them all together to export
all.meta<-bind_rows(meta)
all.nuc<-c(nuc[[1]], nuc[[2]], nuc[[3]], nuc[[4]],
           nuc[[5]], nuc[[6]], nuc[[7]], nuc[[8]])
length(all.nuc)==nrow(all.meta)

#sort by names (group isolate names) and export in batches of 20,000
all.meta<-all.meta %>% arrange(seq_newflu)
all.nuc<-all.nuc[match(all.meta$seq_newflu, names(all.nuc))]

#how many batches at n.per.file seq per file
n.round<-ceiling(nrow(all.meta)/n.per.file)

for (j in 1:n.round){
  #Take successive 20,000 batches, match the fasta
  rng<-c( ((j-1)*n.per.file)+1, (j*n.per.file) ) #c(1, n.per.file) etc
  #for last one, upper will exceed what's available: change to last row index
  if(j==n.round){rng[2]<-nrow(all.meta)}
  temp.meta<-all.meta[(rng[1]:rng[2]), ]
  write.csv(temp.meta, paste0(meta.out,j,".csv"))
  temp.fasta<-all.nuc[which(names(all.nuc) %in% temp.meta$seq_newflu)]
  writeXStringSet(temp.fasta, paste0(fasta.out, j, ".fasta"))
}
```
